items.label: Dialogue-driven
items.text: Dialogue-driven: conversation, interruption, and what is said or deliberately left unsaid carry the scene.

items.label: Action-driven
items.text: Action-driven: movement and physical decisions create consequences.

items.label: Reaction-driven
items.text: Reaction-driven: how characters process what just happened matters most; recalibration, stance shifts, internal weather.

items.label: Problem-driven
items.text: Problem-driven: a practical obstacle reveals character through approach.

items.label: Social-pressure-driven
items.text: Social-pressure-driven: etiquette, hierarchy, or public scrutiny shapes every move; characters perform for an audience, even an audience of one.

items.label: Discovery-driven
items.text: Discovery-driven: noticing, uncovering, or realizing something new reshapes the dynamic.

items.label: Tension-driven
items.text: Tension-driven: nothing explodes, but everything is loaded; silences work, proximity matters, the scene is a held breath.

items.label: Task-driven
items.text: Task-driven: characters do something together; the task itself creates friction, cooperation, rhythm, and revelation.

items.label: Responsive
items.text: The story's momentum is Responsive: the turn resolves {{user}}'s input and lets the world react naturally. Introduce nothing beyond the input, no new consequences, no new events.

source.author: Writer's Block Unlimited author
source.block: Responsive (Response should not progress past input)

items.label: Active
items.text: The story's momentum is Active: the turn resolves {{user}}'s input and carries the scene forward on its own. Characters pursue their own aims and events continue whether or not {{user}} drives them.

source.author: Writer's Block Unlimited author
source.block: Active (Responses are allowed to progress past input)

items.label: Driving
items.text:
The story's momentum is Driving: Scene always ends on an unresolved action, arrival, question, threat or open ended action from characters other than the POV character that demands a response. 
Characters pursue their own aims and events continue whether or not {{user}} drives them.

source.author: Writer's Block Unlimited author
source.block: Driving (Responses should always end on an a scene demanding a response)
